Name: Kenneth's Fresh Baked Goods
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Adds 57 custom baked goods to Kenneth's Bakery - bagels, baguettes, breads, buns, rolls, croissants, muffins, pretzels, pancakes, waffles, donuts, cakes, and pies - each with its own cooking recipe and buffs![/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Requires Kenneth's Bakery - this mod's items are sold across its 3 shops.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Customization: By default, all baked goods appear in Kenneth's Bakery shop. If you prefer a smaller menu and have Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) installed, you can disable individual baked goods to remove them from the shop along with their cooking recipes. Re-enabling a baked good restores it to the shop and its recipe to your kitchen.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]More details can be found in ReadMe.txt.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Please do not reupload this mod or include it in modpacks without permission.[/b][/size]
